items.en: Riyadh's main airport is hit on two consecutive days, flights are cancelled and the city's schools move online
items.zh: 利雅德國際機場連兩天遇襲 —— 首日飛彈攻擊至少 12 死、300 多人受傷，次日客運航廈再遭擊中 1 死 11 傷，沙烏地取消航班、首都學校改遠距上課
items.summary: A Houthi missile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, killing one person and wounding eleven. The strike on the same terminal a day earlier killed at least twelve and injured more than three hundred. Saudi authorities cancelled flights and moved Riyadh schools to distance learning. Houthi-aligned media report Saudi warplanes bombed Sana'a airport and other sites in Yemen in response. The escalation matters because Gulf aviation and export infrastructure is now being hit directly rather than merely threatened, which is what transmits the conflict into oil and freight prices.

items.en: Trump announces an 'energy ceasefire' for Ukraine; Russia bombs a Kharkiv power plant hours later and Zelensky says the deal was news to him
items.zh: 川普在 Truth Social 宣布對烏「能源停火」，俄軍數小時後轟炸哈爾科夫電廠；澤倫斯基稱「我也是看新聞才知道」，歐盟批評川普普丁協議「令人擔憂」並表明對俄制裁continue
items.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire on Truth Social, after which Russia bombed a power plant in Kharkiv. Zelensky said the announcement was news to him and offered to hold elections and halt strikes on Russian energy sites if Putin agrees to a sixty-day ceasefire. Trump separately said it is time for Ukraine to get a new president. European capitals say they were blindsided again, called the Trump-Putin understanding concerning, and confirmed sanctions on Russia will continue. Russian attacks killed at least six civilians on Sunday, including three at a Kharkiv grocery store.

items.en: The United States sanctions the International Criminal Court hours after a former ICC judge wins the Nobel Peace Prize
items.zh: 美國再度制裁國際刑事法院 —— 時間點就在前 ICC 法官 Navi Pillay 獲頒諾貝爾和平獎數小時後；累計已制裁 17 名法官與官員，ICC 呼籲 125 個成員國出面捍衛
items.summary: Washington imposed new sanctions on the International Criminal Court only hours after Navi Pillay, a former ICC judge, was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. The United States has now sanctioned seventeen ICC judges and officials. The court called on its one hundred and twenty-five member states to defend it. The sequencing is the story: a prize intended to confer legitimacy was met within the same news cycle by measures designed to strip it, which tells you the dispute is about whether the institution itself is recognised, not about any single case before it.

items.en: Mass protests against Modi's government sweep Delhi; thousands detained and Rahul Gandhi marches on the Supreme Court
items.zh: 印度反莫迪政府示威席捲德里 —— 警方週六拘留數千人，包含青年主導「蟑螂人民黨」三名領袖（週日獲釋、條件是一年內不得破壞和平），拉胡爾甘地率隊遊行至最高法院
items.summary: Protests against Prime Minister Modi's government swept Delhi over the weekend. Police detained thousands on Saturday, including three leaders of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party, whom a magistrate released on Sunday on condition they not breach the peace for one year. Rahul Gandhi is leading a march toward the Supreme Court. The detail worth holding onto is the release condition: a one-year peace bond functions as a pre-emptive ban on further organising, which is a quieter instrument than prosecution and harder to contest.

items.en: North Korea fires several ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan
items.zh: 北韓向日本海發射多枚彈道飛彈 —— 同日歐洲另有兩則值得記：法國巴黎最老室內市集紅孩兒市場夜間大火燒毀、諾貝爾經濟學獎由美國學者 Hall 與 Woodford 共同獲得
items.summary: North Korea fired several ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan, according to the day's bulletins. The same cycle carried two European items worth noting: an overnight fire gutted the Marche des Enfants Rouges, the oldest covered food market in Paris, and the Nobel Prize in economics went to two Americans, Hall and Woodford. Elsewhere a headmaster was shot at a school in southern France and a fourteen-year-old was arrested, and Raphael Glucksmann won the French left's presidential primary.

items.en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier-class models, and claims the lead on long-term memory
items.zh: Meta 發表首批前沿模型 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full —— 自稱分數對標 GPT-6 Astra 與 Fable 5.1，並在記憶與持續學習基準 MemoryBench 上勝過 Fable、Opus、Astra
items.summary: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12, its first frontier-class models, both larger and stronger on complex work such as coding than the lightweight Muse Spark. Meta's model card claims scores comparable to GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1, and says Wonder beats Fable, Opus and Astra on MemoryBench, a memory and continual-learning benchmark. Wonder is served through the Meta Model API; Wonder Full is restricted to Muse Code subscribers. Training ran at Meta's Prometheus data centre in central Ohio.

items.en: Memory stocks fall together even as Samsung warns of shortages that will push prices up through 2026
items.zh: 記憶體股同步下跌 —— SanDisk 跌逾 6%、美光與 SK 海力士同步走弱，理由是「記憶體競爭疑慮」；但同一週 Samsung 才警告 2026 年缺貨將推升全產業價格，兩個訊號方向相反
items.summary: Micron, SK Hynix and SanDisk all fell on October 12, with SanDisk down more than six percent on what coverage described as memory competition concerns. Memory weakness was the main drag on the Nasdaq composite that day. The contradiction is worth sitting with: in the same period Samsung warned that memory shortages will drive an industry-wide price surge through 2026, and SK Hynix has said tightness may persist beyond 2030. Prices and equities are telling opposite stories, which usually means the market is pricing competitive share loss rather than end demand.

items.en: AI optical and analog names are sold hard as investors pull back from the AI trade
items.zh: AI 光通訊與類比族群重摔 —— Lumentum 跌近 10%、抹掉前一週全部漲幅，Semtech 跌 10.15%、Marvell 跌 3.42%；不是個別公司壞消息，是資金整體從 AI 概念股撤出
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings fell almost ten percent on October 12, erasing the previous week's gains, and Semtech dropped just over ten percent, while Marvell Technology lost three and a half percent. Coverage attributed the moves to investors pulling back from AI stocks rather than to company-specific news. This is the second-order effect of the early-October report that OpenAI's revenue is running roughly twenty billion dollars below prior projections: the selling has rotated from the headline names into the optical, analog and interconnect suppliers one layer down.

items.en: CTBC Brothers beat Uni-Lions 8-2 in the decider and reach the Taiwan Series for a third straight year, setting up the first ever Dragons-Brothers final
items.zh: 中信兄弟 G4 以 8:2 擊敗統一獅、連 3 年闖進台灣大賽 —— 對手是味全龍，史上首次「龍象爭霸」，10/17 開打、7 戰全部排在台北大巨蛋。★ 對你的直接意義：台南不會有台灣大賽賽事，10/21 晚上的交通風險解除
items.summary: CTBC Brothers won the decisive fourth game of the CPBL playoff challenge series 8-2 over the Uni-Lions, reaching the Taiwan Series for a third consecutive year. They face the Wei Chuan Dragons in what is the first Dragons-versus-Brothers final in league history, starting October 17, with all seven potential games scheduled at the Taipei Dome rather than split between home parks. For a reader in Tainan the practical consequence is that the Uni-Lions' elimination removes any prospect of Taiwan Series traffic around the Tainan ballpark in late October.
items.source: 中央社 CNA／NOWnews／Yahoo 奇摩運動

items.en: The four-game Lions-Brothers series drew 81,853 fans, a record for the CPBL challenge round
items.zh: 獅象大戰 4 場打好打滿、累計 81,853 人進場，刷新中職季後挑戰賽紀錄 —— 平均每場超過 2 萬人，統一獅曾在系列賽 0:2 落後後扳平、最終仍倒在生死戰
items.summary: The Uni-Lions and CTBC Brothers went the full four games, drawing a cumulative 81,853 spectators and setting a new attendance record for the CPBL playoff challenge series, an average above twenty thousand per game. The Lions had fought back from a two-game deficit to level the series and force Monday's decider, which would have been only the second comeback from 0-2 in challenge-series history had they completed it. Blake started for the Lions against the Brothers' Cheng Hao-chun in the decider.
items.source: Yahoo 奇摩運動／自由體育

items.en: MLB's championship rounds open: Brewers lead the Dodgers 1-0 in the NLCS, with the ALCS between Rays and Guardians also under way
items.zh: MLB 聯盟冠軍賽開打 —— 釀酒人 10/11 G1 以 2:1 小勝道奇、系列賽 1:0 領先，G2 由山本由伸對上 Logan Henderson；美聯冠軍賽光芒對守護者同步進行。★ 兩場都在台北時間 10/13 上午進行中，結果本期尚未確定
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers lead the Los Angeles Dodgers one game to none in the National League Championship Series after a 2-1 win in game one on October 11. Game two was scheduled for nine in the evening Eastern time on October 12, pairing Yoshinobu Yamamoto, who carried a 1.29 earned run average into the start, against Logan Henderson at 1.80. The American League Championship Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Guardians opened the same day. Both games were still in progress at the time this briefing was generated.

items.en: US universities are abandoning AI detectors, concluding the tools create more injustice than they prevent
items.zh: 美國大學開始放棄 AI 偵測器 —— 面對「作業代寫產業化」，校方發現偵測工具誤判率高、對非母語學生特別不利，與其繼續依賴，不如改設計評量方式
items.summary: American universities are moving away from AI detection software as they grapple with what reporting calls homework scams. The reasoning is that detectors produce false positives at rates institutions cannot defend in an academic-integrity hearing, and that they penalise non-native English writers disproportionately. Separately, researchers have flagged the scale of AI misuse in higher education as very serious. The emerging institutional answer is to redesign assessment, through supervised work and oral defence, rather than to police the text after the fact.

items.en: Unclear institutional AI rules are linked to more academic cheating, not less
items.zh: 研究指出：AI 使用規則「寫得不清楚」的課程，學生違規使用率反而更高 —— 不是學生更想作弊，而是模糊地帶讓人自行解釋成允許。對照組是規則明確的課程，違規率明顯較低
items.summary: A study reported in early October links vague institutional and course-level rules on artificial intelligence to higher rates of academic misconduct among college students. The mechanism is not increased willingness to cheat but ambiguity: where a syllabus does not say what is permitted, students resolve the uncertainty in their own favour and genuinely believe they have complied. Courses with explicit, specific statements of allowed use show markedly lower violation rates. The practical implication for a student is to get the rule in writing before using a tool, not after.

items.en: Greece moves to ban social media for under-15s
items.zh: 希臘將立法禁止 15 歲以下使用社群媒體 —— 成為歐洲在青少年心理健康與螢幕時間議題上立法最激進的國家之一，同日布魯塞爾也舉行大規模氣候遊行
items.summary: Greece is introducing a ban on social media use for children under fifteen, according to the day's European bulletins, placing it among the most interventionist European states on the question of adolescent screen time and mental health. The policy direction follows a broader shift in which governments have stopped treating platform access as a parental matter and begun legislating an age floor directly. The open question such bans leave unanswered is enforcement: age verification at national scale is the part that has defeated comparable measures elsewhere.

items.en: The frontier-model price band is now crowded: Muse Wonder lands at $4 in and $20 out, deliberately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol
items.zh: 前沿模型定價戰白熱化 —— Meta Muse Wonder 定在每百萬 token 輸入 4 美元、輸出 20 美元，刻意與 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Sol 同一價位帶；差異化不打價格，改打「主動記憶」
items.summary: Meta priced Muse Wonder at four dollars per million input tokens and twenty per million output, which coverage describes as roughly level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol. Matching rather than undercutting is the signal: Meta is not buying share on price but competing on capability, and the capability it chose to lead with is active memory, the retention and synthesis of user-supplied information over long periods. Wonder Full, the stronger variant, is withheld from the API and reserved for Muse Code subscribers, which keeps the best model inside Meta's own product.

items.en: The OpenAI revenue shortfall is still setting the tone for AI equities a week later
items.zh: OpenAI 營收缺口仍在發酵 —— 10/08 報導稱其營收比先前預估少約 200 億美元，當天引爆那斯達克與晶片股賣壓；一週後的 10/12，那斯達克仍跌 0.44%，而道瓊同日上漲 0.38%
items.summary: The report in early October that OpenAI's revenue is running about twenty billion dollars below prior projections remains the organising fact for AI equities. It drove chipmakers and the Nasdaq 100 lower on October 8, and the pattern was still visible on October 12, when the Nasdaq composite fell 0.44 percent while the Dow Jones rose 0.38 percent. The divergence between the two indices on the same day is the cleanest available measure of how narrowly the selling is targeted at AI capital-expenditure exposure rather than at equities generally.

items.en: Memory supply is tightening while memory shares fall, and the quantum names moved only with the market
items.zh: 記憶體基本面與股價背道而馳 —— Samsung 警告 2026 缺貨將推升全產業價格、SK 海力士稱短缺可能延續到 2030 年之後，但 10/12 記憶體股同步下跌。★ 量子運算：本窗口內沒有可交叉確認的重大進展，清單內 IONQ、QBTS、RGTI 等僅隨大盤波動
items.summary: Samsung has warned that memory shortages will drive an industry-wide price surge through 2026, and SK Hynix has suggested the tightness may last beyond 2030, yet Micron, SK Hynix and SanDisk all fell together on October 12. When contract prices and share prices diverge this cleanly, the market is usually repricing competitive position rather than demand. On quantum computing, no verifiable milestone surfaced inside this forty-eight-hour window; the quantum names on the watchlist moved with the broad market and nothing company-specific was confirmed.

items.en: Fujii Kaze plays Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31, still the only Taiwan date by anyone on your list
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 10/31 高雄國家體育場 —— 18 天後，仍是清單 16 組歌手裡唯一有台灣場的一位；巡演接著是福岡 11/14–15、大阪 12/10・12–13、東京巨蛋 12/19–20、曼谷 12/26，首爾 2027 年 1 月，香港場已取消
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour reaches Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31, 2026, a date added after the original routing was announced. It is eighteen days away and remains the only Taiwan show by any of the sixteen artists on the tracking list. The tour then plays Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka on November 14 and 15, Kyocera Dome Osaka on December 10 and 12 to 13, Tokyo Dome on December 19 and 20, and Bangkok on December 26, with Seoul following in January 2027. The Hong Kong date was cancelled.

items.en: YOASOBI announce a ten-city Asia dome and stadium tour for 2026-27 that includes Taipei, Hong Kong, Seoul and Singapore
items.zh: YOASOBI 宣布「ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027」—— 日本 5 城（大阪、名古屋、福岡、札幌、東京）＋海外台北、首爾、香港、新加坡，另有 1 城待公布。★ 有台北場但日期與售票資訊都還沒出來，這是接下來最該盯的一筆
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced the ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027, spanning five Japanese cities (Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Tokyo) and four confirmed overseas stops in Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore, with one further overseas city still to be named. No individual dates and no ticket-sale information have been published; the announcement says only that more details are coming. Given that dome and stadium shows in Taipei sell out on the first on-sale day, the actionable step is to watch for the date announcement rather than the show itself.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's sixth album is out and their first arena tour in three years is under way, with Pollstar calling them the band redefining the scale of Japanese touring
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張原創專輯已於 9/30 發行，三年來首次 arena 巡迴同步啟動 —— Pollstar 10/06 專文稱其正把日本演唱會產業推上新量級（arena 與 stadium 同時填滿）；目前公布場次集中在日本，尚無台灣場
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE released their sixth original full-length album on September 30 and launched their first arena tour in three years alongside it. Pollstar ran a feature on October 6 describing the band as dominating arenas and stadiums simultaneously and elevating Japanese touring to a new scale, which is the industry framing rather than fan framing and is why it is worth noting here. Announced dates remain concentrated in Japan; no Taiwan show has been confirmed, so this is a watch item rather than an action item.

items.zh: 清單其餘 13 組本窗口無新公告 —— Yuuri、YUIKA、Ado、King Gnu、back number、LiSA、Official髭男dism、Aimer、米津玄師、Vaundy、tuki.、RADWIMPS、あいみょん 在 10/11–10/13 這 48 小時內沒有可確認的巡演、專輯或周邊消息

market.highlight: ★★★ 今天這一區只有三件事：**①台股開低走高、守住 49,300 —— 這是今天最值得記的一筆。**早盤因台積電 ADR 連跌與 OpenAI 營收消息一度大跌 544 點、下探 48,947 點，上演「4 萬 9 保衛戰」，**但終場只跌 11.48 點收 49,301.96（-0.02%）**，幾乎抹平全部跌幅。拉抬的是金融股（富邦金、台新新光金控、中信金、國泰金），台積電收 2,540 元、僅跌 10 元（-0.39%）。**休市三天累積的恐慌，在一個交易日內被消化掉了。**　**②美股同日分化得非常乾淨**：道瓊 +0.38% 收 51,851、S&P 500 -0.06% 收 7,807、那斯達克 -0.44% 收 27,246。**同一天、同一個市場，傳產漲、科技跌 —— 這是「資金從 AI 撤出」最清楚的一次呈現，不是全面下跌。**　**③今天 ≥5% 的異動全部在清單外，而且全部集中在 AI 供應鏈的第二層**：Semtech -10.15%、Lumentum -9.9%、SanDisk -6%，反向則是 Figs +12%。**清單內 50 餘檔，今天沒有一檔確認 ≥5%** —— 這本身就是訊息：你的清單偏大型權值，波動被稀釋了。
market.note: ★ 開盤前要分清楚的三條線：　**①【台股：10/12 是「驚嚇但沒受傷」的一天，不要只看收盤數字】**加權指數收 49,301.96、**跌 11.448 點（-0.02%）**。但盤中最低下探 48,947 點、一度跌 544 點 —— **如果你只看收盤，會完全錯過今天真正發生的事。**觸發點是週末美股 AI 殺盤（OpenAI 營收傳低於預期、費半單日重摔約 3.39%、台積電 ADR 兩天累跌約 4%），台指期夜盤一度掉到 48,705。**開盤反映了全部壞消息，然後買盤把它收回來。**台積電開 2,510 元、盤中最低見 2,520 元附近，終場收 2,540 元、跌 10 元（-0.39%）。成交值：財報狗記為約 **8,894.58 億元**、經濟日報報導記為約 **8,439 億元**，**兩個來源不一致，請以下單平台為準**（前一交易日約 9,201.72 億元，無論採哪個數字都是量縮）。　**②【台股盤面：今天是「金融撐盤、電子分化」，和 10/08 完全相反】**拉抬指數的是**富邦金、台新新光金控、中信金、國泰金**等金融權值 —— 而 10/08 金融股才是當天最弱（-1.68%）。**漲且量大**：大立光、國巨、世芯-KY、台光電、華通、日月光投控、鴻勁、長榮、欣銓（**台光電、日月光、華通、世芯-KY 都在你的清單內，而且是逆勢上漲**）。**弱且量大**：聯發科、南亞、台達電、南亞科、台塑、創意、聯電、鴻海、金像電、臻鼎-KY、友達（**聯發科、台達電、南亞科、創意、鴻海、金像電 都在清單內**）。★ **可以拿去用的一句話：你的清單今天內部打對台 —— CCL／封測／ASIC 設計（台光電、日月光、世芯）走強，而記憶體／散熱電源／AI 伺服器鏈（南亞科、台達電、鴻海、金像電）走弱。這和美股「記憶體與光通訊被殺、傳產與金融被買」是同一個方向。**另有報導提及長榮、萬海、台星科等出現漲停，但**未確認為收盤結果，列為示意**。　**③【美股：分化比漲跌更重要】**道瓊 +0.38%（51,851）、S&P 500 -0.06%（7,807）、那斯達克 -0.44%（27,246）。類股上**通訊服務與民生防禦領漲、科技落後**。黃金跌 0.64% 至 4,167.56 美元，10 年期公債殖利率升 0.01 個百分點至 5.24%（**債市當天休市，殖利率變動參考價值較低**）。個股：**Meta +3.4%**（發表 Muse Wonder 前沿模型，見科技區）、**Salesforce 因分析師調升評等走高**、**NVIDIA -1.3%**、**Marvell -3.42%**、**比特幣 -1.3%**。　★ **今天這一區唯一需要你動手的事：沒有。**股市區今天是背景資訊 —— **真正要你動手的三件事全部在「信件」與「行程」區（兩場期中考＋四個複習時段）。**如果今天時間有限，**先按那兩顆行事曆按鈕，再回來看這一區。**

movers.name: 🇺🇸 清單外最熱①　Semtech —— 今天全市場最大跌幅，類比晶片被當成 AI 代理股賣掉
movers.reason: **這是 10/12 全市場確認的最大單日跌幅，而且沒有任何公司個別壞消息。**報導把它和 Lumentum 歸在同一個原因：**投資人整體從 AI 概念股撤出。**　★ 為什麼放在最上面：**Semtech 不在你的清單內，但它說明的事情直接適用於你的清單。**Semtech 做的是類比與連接晶片 —— 在 AI 資料中心裡屬於「第二層供應商」，不是 NVIDIA 那種主角，而是主角的上下游。**當市場開始殺第二層供應商，意思是「對 AI 資本支出的懷疑」已經從情緒變成對供應鏈營收的實際下修預期。**　★ **對照你的清單該怎麼看**：你的美股清單裡性質最接近 Semtech 的是 **Marvell（MRVL，資料中心、網通、ASIC）**，今天 **-3.42%**；台股裡性質最接近的是 **台光電（2383）、金像電（2368）、欣興（3037）** 這些 PCB／CCL 標的。**而今天台光電反而是「漲且量大」—— 這個分歧值得記住：美股在殺第二層，台股的第二層卻在漲。**兩者不可能長期背離，接下來幾天看哪一邊先收斂。

movers.name: 🇺🇸 清單外最熱②　Lumentum —— 跌近 10%，一天抹掉前一週全部漲幅
movers.reason: **Lumentum 做 AI 資料中心的光通訊元件（光收發模組、雷射），是 AI 建設最直接的受益者之一。今天跌近 10%，而且報導明確寫「erasing the prior week's gains」—— 一天抹掉一週。**　★ **這一筆比 Semtech 更值得想，因為它是「漲回去又跌下來」**：前一週它因為 AI 題材大漲，這一週因為同一個題材反轉而全數吐回。**這種「一週內來回」的型態，通常代表籌碼是短線資金而不是長線持有者 —— 也就是說，這個族群的價格現在對新聞的敏感度遠高於對基本面的敏感度。**　★ **實際用法**：你的清單沒有光通訊純股，但 **華通（2313，PCB、衛星通訊概念）、欣興（3037，載板）** 在 AI 資料中心供應鏈上的位置與它相鄰。**如果你在觀察這一類標的，今天學到的是「它們的波動幅度是大型權值股的 5–10 倍」—— 風險標示上你的清單把華通列為「高」、欣興列為「中高」，今天的美股對照證明這個標示是對的。**

movers.name: 🇺🇸 清單外最熱③　SanDisk 跌逾 6%，而 Samsung 同期在警告記憶體「缺貨漲價」
movers.price: 單日 -6% 以上，理由為「記憶體競爭疑慮」
movers.reason: **SanDisk（NAND Flash）今天跌逾 6%，美光與 SK 海力士同步走弱，是那斯達克 -0.44% 的最大單一拖累。**報導給的理由是「memory competition concerns」。　★ **這一筆的價值在於它和基本面明顯矛盾，而矛盾本身就是資訊**：同一個時期，**Samsung 警告 2026 年記憶體缺貨將推升全產業價格，SK 海力士更稱短缺可能延續到 2030 年之後。****合約價在漲，股價在跌。**當這兩件事同時發生，市場通常不是在反映「需求轉弱」，而是在反映「某一家的市佔要被搶走」—— 也就是競爭格局的重分配，不是產業的衰退。　★ **直接對照你的清單**：記憶體分類有 **南亞科（2408，DRAM、DDR4/DDR5）、華邦電（2344）、旺宏（2337）**，美股有 **Micron（MU，HBM、DRAM）**。**今天南亞科在台股是「弱且量大」，與美股記憶體同步 —— 這一組是今天台美最同步的族群。**★ 要分清楚的是：**漲價對「有 HBM 產能的人」是利多，對「只有傳統 DRAM／NAND 的人」是成本與競爭壓力。這就是為什麼同一條「記憶體漲價」新聞，不同公司股價會往反方向走。**
